parts.title: A place outdoors
questions: How often do you spend time in an outdoor public space?
What time of day do you prefer to go outside?
What makes an outdoor place comfortable for you?
Is there a place near your home that changes a lot with the seasons?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe an outdoor place you would improve for people who spend time there.
questions: Say where the place is and who uses it.
Describe what currently makes it difficult to use.
Explain one change you would make.
Say how you would tell whether the change helped.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: How can a public place meet the needs of people who use it at different times?
When should a city use temporary changes before making permanent ones?
What kinds of evidence could show that an outdoor space has become more usable?
Who might be overlooked if planners only consult the people who already visit?
